reasons: Correctly identified as missing: the cited paragraphs contain only a Kubient IP warranty (p0040), a trademark carve-out (p0065) and a Customer liability statement for Content (p0025) — none allocates ownership of deliverables, work product or Customer data, so the rule's subject matter is genuinely absent.

The inserted section 13A reaches the preferred position with the smallest workable edit: Customer retains Content/Properties/Requests and data, Customer owns deliverables with an express Kubient assignment, Kubient retains the Auction Platform and pre-existing tools, Customer gets a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to embedded Kubient materials, and joint ownership is expressly excluded.

Insertion after the Disclaimer (p0062) is a sensible placement given no existing IP article, and it uses existing defined terms (Content, Properties, Services, Term) consistently; the 'as between the Parties' framing and the assignment mechanic sit compatibly with the Kubient ownership warranty in p0040.
Comment is accurate, first-person plural, appropriately concise, carries the [Playbook] prefix and explains both what was added and the underlying position without lecturing.

The one arguable extension — limiting Kubient's use of Customer Data to providing the Services — is closely tied to the rule's 'no assignment of our data to the Vendor' objective and is not material scope creep; deterministic checks confirm no residual assignment of Customer IP or data to the Vendor.
